$sources: The museum's picture-frame moulding: the as-built Salon gilt frame, a carved Louis XV / Barbizon moulding (windows/Source/MuseeVision/Frames/MuseeFrame.cpp, SalonGilt: its profile, its width rule and its 6 mm sight lip), re-set with A outward from the canvas's edge and B up from the canvas's face, in units of the moulding's width, and drawn from the outside edge inward so its solid lies on its left.
The width rule, 0.09 m + 0.015 m per metre of the canvas's longer side, held between 0.10 and 0.14 m: Data/Stages/salon/Finishes.json, salon.frame.gilt.
The rebate stands 2 mm clear of the canvas's edge all round, so the stretcher can move with the room's humidity without binding in its frame.

face.source: SalonGilt: the back-edge bead, the outer cavetto, the raised ribbon, the carved ogee, the deep cove, the astragal, the sanded frieze and the sight-edge bead, ending on the canvas's face at the lip.
